comments.author: Althelia
comments.body:
I asked someone about a CC not long after I started UWO, and the response was essentially, "Why would you ever want one? It doesn't have enough crew to use its cannons effectively." I'm glad I ignored him and picked the ship up anyway.

I've been running with a 1/5 CC for a little while now, and I have to say I love the agility on the ship. I've even asked a shipbuilder to help me improve it to 5/5 with Repair Support, Medical Support, and Emergency Acceleration. Eventually, I hope to get it up to 6/6, but I'm only 30/28/38, so the last step will have to wait for a few levels. The CC is very good at its job: staying out of danger, and helping its allies.

I don't know why people tend to dismiss support ships as being "worse" than other battleships when they serve a completely different function. Of course they're not going to be the most effective in a 1-on-1 battle, but they'll definitely shine in a well-balanced fleet. It's not just this game; it's pretty much any multiplayer game I've ever encountered. Supports in general are scoffed at for being weaker when their talents lie elsewhere.

Anyway, I apologize for the long-winded message, but I felt the need to defend the Commander's Corvette after I had some first-hand experience with the ship. To all of you new players out there: Don't just listen to one person. Dig around for more information, or better yet, try it yourselves!

-Althelia of the Crazy.Seamen
